executiveSummary: System conditions remain stable and overall operational readiness remains Green, with all major flood protection assets operational and second-quarter inspections nearing completion. Project execution is a major focus, with construction underway on the LPV Access Bridge and Orpheum Slope Paving projects, the West Return Wall Splash Pad transitioning into closeout, and engineering advancing several critical flood protection initiatives. While staffing shortages remain the primary readiness challenge, the agency remains focused on hurricane season operations, project execution, workforce development, and infrastructure reliability.
maintenanceActivities: Floodwalls, levees, gates, and valves continue routine inspection and maintenance activities with no impacts to system readiness.
Seasonal storm readiness measures, including sandbag staging and facility preparation, are underway.
Critical facilities, generators, and support infrastructure remain operational.
Routine equipment maintenance and repairs ongoing.
Rotational Valve Testing – 84 of 105 valves inspected in Q2.
